name: X (Twitter)

counting.notes: Uses twitter-text v3 weighted counting: ASCII/Latin=1, CJK & most emojis=2, every http(s) URL=flat 23 chars via t.co.

hashtags.excessBehavior: More than 2 hashtags triggers spam heuristics and hurts Heavy Ranker engagement.
hashtags.notes: X Help Center recommends <=2 hashtags; hashtags are banned in X Ads.

links.recommendedStrategy: Publish native value in post 1 and place external links in the follow-up reply of a thread.
links.notes: Non-Premium link-only posts show severely suppressed engagement; X pay-per-use API also prices link posts higher than text-only.

oauth.gotcha: Requires offline.access scope for refresh token. Concurrent refresh workers trigger RFC 9700 rotation race invalidating the entire token chain; enforce single-flight locking. v1.1 media endpoints (upload.x.com) are sunset — use v2 /2/media/upload flow. Official POST /2/tweets API docs cap media_ids at 4 photos (native/web expanded to 20, undocumented in API). Starting a reply post with @handle hides it from non-mutual followers' timelines. Pay-per-use API prices link posts higher than text/media-only.

sources: X Developer Documentation (twitter-text weighted counting, t.co 23-char rule, Cards summary_large_image, v2 media upload, 20-image expansion 2026)
Buffer Multi-Million Post Link Engagement Study (2025)
X API v1.1 media upload sunset — must use v2 /2/media/upload/initialize+APPEND+FINALIZE flow
